open_questions: First Marvin deep dive; batch onboard 2026-06-03.
No third-party sources indexed; stance rests on filings only.
Entry band **$250–255** for ~15% base annual return is model-derived, not human-approved.
thesis: Cboe Global Markets operates exchange, clearing, and market-data infrastructure across options, equities, futures, and foreign exchange. **[Fact]** Customers pay transaction, clearing, listing, and subscription fees; the company does not take principal market risk. **[Fact]** FY2025 total revenues were **$4,714.2 million** (+15% versus **$4,094.5 million** in FY2024); operating income **$1,467.1 million**; net income **$1,100.0 million** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260220_rpt20251231_acc0001628280_26_010013.htm`). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 net revenues were **$1,272.8 million** (+6% versus **$1,195.0 million** in Q1 2025); net income **$385.7 million** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-Q_20260501_rpt20260331_acc0001628280_26_029112.htm`). The franchise is anchored in proprietary index options (SPX, VIX) and a multi-venue U.S. equities stack (BZX, BYX, EDGA, EDGX) plus European and Asia-Pacific derivatives.
why_market_wrong: There is no dated payoff or structural discount. **[Inference]** FY2025 and Q1 2026 benefited from elevated volatility and index trading; the stock at **~$285** embeds a premium multiple on strong recent cash flow. **[Inference]** Our base return uses FY2025 free cash flow per share (**$16.00**), not a peak run rate from Q1 2026 alone. Return is franchise earnings power at price, not a mispricing with a known catalyst date.
